Parent: #1202. Bounded source-only assessment of two complete physical-gap families retained in the frozen 711-family accounting. The selected families contain 15 complete components and 9 full current administrative contacts. This is a source-fitness investigation, not a claim of mapped land, water, rightful boundary, or repair authority.

Both rows have `cause_status=unknown`, `physical_authority=unapproved`, `source_fitness=unapproved-for-all-components`, and source-relative `mapped-land-support` counts (12 and 3). These are routing labels/diagnostics, not physical class findings. All 15 remain in scope, including the non-compatible siblings.

## Cross-scope review and collision result

A fresh all-state scan of 1,430 issues and 450 PRs found no exact family ID or component ID in any issue/PR body; exact-ID search across issue/PR discussion found no family/component matches. The nine contacts are already named in open issues #318 (three KGZ contacts) and #319 (six TJK contacts). Both remain `status:ready`, open, and unclaimed; neither names these physical-component IDs. Treat #318/#319 as explicit regional/source context and preserve all shared contact references. Do not duplicate or close their geographic membership/semantic review, infer a territorial classification, or claim their broader scope. The selected output is only the two named physical-gap families. No active exact-scope claim was found.

The selected families are subsets of operational batch `gap-operational-batch:1df1240f1cba596d821d83f5`, whose complete original context is 85 fine families / 441 components. Do not call the two selected families the whole operational batch. Pin and preserve the full batch membership.

## Acceptance

1. Reconcile all 15 component rows, all 9 complete contact features, all selected IDs, original support/unknown categories, and full operational-batch/neighbor context against the pinned complete routing, source-comparison and custody inputs. Preserve source-relative measures without relabeling them as physical facts.
2. Authenticate the complete simplified geoBoundaries KGZ ADM2 and TJK ADM2 products consumed by the pinned recipe, including every feature, metadata, source URLs, represented vintages, attribution and license claims. Verify all nine selected features by full `shapeID` and compare every complete component with both complete products and relevant full neighbors; no clipping or geometry change.
3. Assess candidate-scale independent official/appropriate administrative, dated physical/water, and boundary references. Retain full raw bytes where permitted plus stable URL, publisher/role, observation/effective dates, native CRS/datum/units, precision/resolution, registration/accuracy, extent, and reuse terms. Compare only where evidence is fit. Report unavailable/unsuitable sources and evidence needed next.
4. Keep authority, effective date, lineage/cause, registration/accuracy, physical land/water, applicable rights, and ownership unknown unless direct candidate-level evidence supports them. Do not infer political conclusions or convert unknown to water. Preserve all non-compatible siblings.
5. Deliver a bounded, reproducible source-evidence packet with whole-file source custody, complete joins for all 15 components and 9 features, method/code/runtime bindings, two fresh runs, positive and negative controls, and exact unavailable-source limits. Record and admit the full input, runtime, output, final-evidence budgets and every destination before any geometric calculation. Any GIS must stay limited to these 15 local-family components and pass fresh full input, output, runtime, RAM and storage admission during an explicitly coordinated memory window, without concurrent substantial root-global GIS.
6. Source-research only under `research/geography/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-gap-source-fitness-20261007/`. No geometry edits, source assignment, hierarchy changes, import, approval, release, publication, or deployment. One PR maximum and independent exact-head review required.
